The '''B2 Assault''' was an enhanced [[B2-HA super battle droid/Legends|B2-HA super battle droid]] that the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] deployed during the [[Third battle of Felucia]] to patrol the [[Unidentified Separatist base|Separatist base]]. It was equip with tougher armor, built in laser cannon and cannon arm than the B2-HA series super battle droid. During the battle, the famed [[Clone commando/Legends|Clone Commando]] [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]] commissioned a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] to destroy this droid.
